model: VOC Series air quality transmitter (BACnet MS/TP)
applies_to: Greystone VOC series room air quality transmitters (VOC with RH and temperature) with BACnet MS/TP and optional relay.
summary: The VOC Series is a Greystone room air quality transmitter with native BACnet MS/TP. VOC (as an index or ppb), RH and temperature are Analog Inputs; offsets and relay setpoint, hysteresis and delay are Analog Values; Binary Values set units, override, the TVOC clean-air reference and the Bluetooth link, and Multi-State Values assign the relay and the display.
notes: Points from the object table on page 1 of the setup guide; names kept as printed (e.g. "Set Overide", "Relay Hysterisis").
Each AI reads -1000 on a sensor error.
Relay setpoint and hysteresis ranges follow MV 1, e.g. VOC index 100-500, TVOC 100-1000 ppb, RH 20-90 %RH, temperature 5-40 °C.
Multistate objects are MSV in the guide; listed here as MV. Access from the PICS: AV, BV and MSV Present_Value are writable.

source.title: VOC Series Air Quality Transmitter - Setup Guide for BACnet Communication

integration.summary: Set the MS/TP MAC in the menu, pick VOC units with BV 1, then read VOC, RH and temperature. Treat -1000 as a sensor error.

minimum_points.name: VOC Sensor Value
minimum_points.why: VOC index or TVOC ppb (per BV 1)

setup: Device instance defaults to 381003 (381000 + MAC); it stops following the MAC once written over BACnet.
gotchas: Only write BV 5 (new TVOC reference) when the air is known to be clean; the reading is reset to 50 ppb.

points.name: VOC Sensor Value
points.description: VOC: 0-500 index or 0-1000 ppb per BV 1

points.name: Relay Setpoint
points.description: Relay trip point; range follows MV 1 (default 20 VOC index)

points.name: Relay Hysterisis
points.description: Relay hysteresis; range follows MV 1 (default 20 VOC index)

points.name: Set New TVOC Reference
points.description: Write 1 in clean air to reset the TVOC reference (reads 50 ppb)
